onto.description: the base branch's real name (main on most repos) or the feature the feature was moved onto; "" when the features above it were restacked

restacked.description: each branch moved (or whose record moved), in the order pushed; under --plan, what would be

parent.description: "main" (a placeholder for the base branch, whatever its name) or the feature it is stacked on now

to.description: its head now; equal to from when only its record moved

forked_at.description: its fork point now; empty on the base branch

pending.description: the features not restacked because it stopped, the one it stopped at first; empty when it finished
